removeLeadBody: {name} will stay a member of the circle and keep their entries.
removeFacilitatorBody: {name} will stay a member of the challenge and keep their entries.
stepDownLeadBody: You'll stay a member of the circle and keep your entries, but you'll no longer be able to manage the circle, its challenges or their facilitators. Only an admin can make you a lead again.
stepDownFacilitatorBody: You'll stay a member of the challenge and keep your entries, but you'll no longer be able to edit the challenge or log evidence for it. A circle lead will need to make you a facilitator again if needed.
lastLeadHint: A circle needs at least one lead. Add another lead before removing this one.
lastFacilitatorHint: A challenge needs at least one facilitator. Add another facilitator before removing this one.
manageLeadsOnCircle: Circle leads are added and removed on the circle's page.
manageFacilitatorsOnChallenge: Facilitators are added and removed on the challenge's page.
leadRequired: Add at least one circle lead.
